parameters.query: SELECT m.id AS media_id, m.original_filename, m.local_path, m.is_video, m.friends_identified, m.faces_recognized, m.session_id, s.session_name, array_length(m.friends_identified, 1) AS friend_count FROM media_files m LEFT JOIN hangout_sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE m.status = 'processed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delivery_logs dl WHERE dl.media_file_id = m.id AND dl.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')) ORDER BY m.taken_at ASC;

SELECT subject_name, whatsapp_jid, display_name, send_preference FROM friends_contacts WHERE subject_name = '{{ $json._friendToLookup || $json._routing.friendName }}' AND is_active = true AND consent_given = true LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO delivery_logs (media_file_id, session_id, recipient_type, recipient_jid, recipient_name, sent_as, status, whatsapp_msg_id, sent_at, idempotency_key) SELECT '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.mediaId }}'::uuid, {{ $('Encode Media').item.json.sessionId ? "'" + $('Encode Media').item.json.sessionId + "'::uuid" : 'NULL' }}, '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.recipientType }}', '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.recipientJid }}', '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.recipientName }}', '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.sendAs }}', 'sent', '{{ $json.key?.id || $json.messageId || '' }}', NOW(), '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.mediaId }}:{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.recipientJid }}' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delivery_logs WHERE media_file_id = '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.mediaId }}'::uuid AND recipient_jid = '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.recipientJid }}' AND status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read'));
UPDATE media_files SET status = 'delivered', delivered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Encode Media').item.json.mediaId }}'::uuid;
UPDATE media_files SET status = 'skipped', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.media_id }}'::uuid AND status = 'processed';
UPDATE media_files SET status = 'skipped', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.mediaId }}'::uuid AND status = 'processed';
